scope: Corollary 4.7 (Signs of the soft pressure) of the manuscript “Computing the Random 3-SAT Threshold” (preprints/Computing-the-Random-3-SAT-Threshold-September-27-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 235 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 be7bde6cd4e513e1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed real 0 ≤ a < α and every fixed β > 0, lim inf n→∞ 1 n E log Zn(a, β) ≥ 0. (4.15) For every fixed real a > α, some positive integer β satisfies lim sup n→∞ 1 n E log Zn(a, β) < 0. (4.16)
